jungle_clearing.name: Jungle Clearing
jungle_clearing.description: You stand in a humid jungle clearing. A dense canopy of trees surrounds you, and the air is thick with the scent of exotic flowers. To the east, you see a faint outline of what appears to be an ancient stone structure, partially overgrown with vines.

temple_entrance.name: Temple Entrance
temple_entrance.description: You are at the entrance of a massive stone temple. Hieroglyphs cover the weathered walls, depicting ancient rituals. A grand archway leads further inside to the west.

grand_foyer.name: Grand Foyer
grand_foyer.description: The grand foyer is a vast chamber with a high, vaulted ceiling. Pillars carved with intricate designs support the structure. Passages lead to the north, east, and south.

hall_of_echoes.name: Hall of Echoes
hall_of_echoes.description: A long, narrow hall where every sound reverberates. Faint carvings on the walls depict ancient scholars. There's a passage to the south and a heavy, ornate door to the east.

chamber_of_reflections.name: Chamber of Reflections
chamber_of_reflections.description: This circular chamber has highly polished obsidian walls that reflect your image countless times. A pedestal in the center has a small indentation. There's a passage to the west.

garden_of_stone.name: Garden of Stone
garden_of_stone.description: An eerie garden filled with petrified trees and statues of strange creatures. The air is still and heavy. A path leads east.

archive_of_whispers.name: Archive of Whispers
archive_of_whispers.description: Dusty shelves filled with ancient scrolls and crumbling texts line this room. A large stone sphinx statue sits in the center, its eyes seemingly following you. There's a passage to the west.

puzzle.question: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with wind. What am I?

statue_of_the_serpent.name: Statue of the Serpent
statue_of_the_serpent.description: A colossal statue of a coiled serpent dominates this chamber. Its eyes glow faintly. There's a passage to the south and a hidden passage to the east, behind the statue.

altar_of_the_sun.name: Altar of the Sun
altar_of_the_sun.description: This sacred chamber is bathed in a soft, golden light. A large altar stands in the center, with an empty pedestal. The air hums with ancient energy. Passages lead south and west.

final_puzzle.win_message: As you place the Sunstone on the altar, a blinding light erupts, filling the chamber. The temple trembles, and a voice echoes, 'The ancient power is restored! You have completed your quest!' Congratulations, you have won the game!

key.name: a small brass key
key.description: It's a small, ornate brass key. It looks like it might unlock a chest.

mirror.name: a polished obsidian mirror
mirror.description: A perfectly smooth, reflective obsidian mirror. It seems to hum with a faint energy.

ancient_coin.name: an ancient coin
ancient_coin.description: A heavy, tarnished coin with an unfamiliar symbol. It might be valuable.

archive_key.name: a skeletal key
archive_key.description: A strange, skeletal key. It looks like it could unlock a very old door.

sunstone.name: the legendary Sunstone
sunstone.description: A radiant crystal that pulses with warm light. This is the artifact you've been searching for!
